prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for lemon balm citrus tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single hand-thrown ceramic cup filled with pale chartreuse-green lemon balm tea, placed slightly off-center (lower right). Scattered around the cup on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: a small bundle of bright green lemon balm leaves (heart-shaped, slightly serrated), two thin yellow lemon slices, and one cinnamon stick. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Leaves and lemon slices have confident silhouettes, NOT painterly. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The cup has a subtle sage glazed rim. Bright morning light from upper left casts a faint warm shadow below the cup. Feels uplifting, citrusy, gently-energizing. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
